claim: Patchline ships a mediation analysis decomposing how much effect flows through each gate family. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the mediation claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make mediation-analysis-gate`.
